entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We can't know for *sure* of course..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't know for *sure* of course, but the centrist trio always stick together and Isabel is their mouthpiece. She's the only one willing to talk, so we have to take our chances with her."

entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Yes. We might need him for the las..."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "Let's talk about our next steps."

entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Heron might be a possibility, yes...."
entries.dialogueText: "Heron might be a possibility, yes. But I advise against dealing with any of them. If we can persuade Isabel, we can get the votes we need."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""When will Isabel be here?""

entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""She's not entirely scared about th..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's not entirely scared about the situation but then again none of the court even believed that you would pass the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at her watch."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at her watch.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""So maybe she's feeling the pressur..."
entries.dialogueText: "So maybe she's feeling the pressure on her now. But in any case, we'll discover that soon enough."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I think she's our best bet. We have a meeting with her now, after all."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""She must also be under pressure af..."
entries.dialogueText: "She must also be under pressure after the anti-corruption police's raids against her fellow colleagues."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We have to keep up the pressure.""
entries.dialogueText: "We have to keep up the pressure."
entries.menuText: "We have to keep up the pressure."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nobody is unbreakable.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody is unbreakable."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Although they have immunity, they..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although they have immunity, they are scared that these would go public. We have already gained a few more votes in the Court but I'm not sure more Old Guards would jump on the same wagon."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""It is the Old Guard that are disre..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is the Old Guard that are disrespecting their positions. But we will hopefully take care of that soon."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What has Orso been doing?""
entries.dialogueText: "What has Orso been doing?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good. The whole Court must finally..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. The whole Court must finally learn to back down."
entries.menuText: "Good. The whole Court must finally learn to back down."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Orso and Heron have a tight grip o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Orso and Heron have a tight grip on everybody."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""You know who I'm dealing with, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "You know who I'm dealing with, Mr. President. It's not easy."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""The efforts are bearing fruit.""
entries.dialogueText: "The efforts are bearing fruit."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I only know about the two Justices..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only know about the two Justices I've mentioned earlier who are with me. So we have three votes there."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We are not in a battle against the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are not in a battle against the Court here, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""These old men have a pride as vast..."
entries.dialogueText: "These old men have a pride as vast as Merkopa, they're not easy game."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""The investigations are still going..."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna

entries.dialogueText: "With the ongoing investigations of the anti-corruption force, I'm sure we will have a strong position against most of the Old Guards regarding their impeachment."
